**❌ MISSING** — No code anywhere in `cli/` or `cloud/` checks npm/PyPI/crates.io for phantom packages. ### 3.2 Vulnerability scanning (SAST patterns)
**⚠️ PARTIAL** — `security.rs` implements **secret detection only** (AWS keys, GitHub tokens, private keys, generic secrets, emails, high-entropy strings). It does NOT perform general SAST vulnerability scanning (SQL injection, XSS, path traversal, unsafe deserialization, etc.). The scanner blocks/warns on secrets but has no broader vulnerability pattern matching.

### 3.3 License compliance
**❌ MISSING** — No code checks for copyleft license patterns in generated code. No SPDX matching, no license header scanning, no similarity detection against known copyleft-licensed code. Only referenced in plan files.

### 3.4 Quality scoring (complexity metrics, test coverage)
**❌ MISSING** — No complexity metric calculation (cyclomatic complexity, cognitive complexity, etc.) exists in source code. No test coverage threshold enforcement. The `waste.rs` module analyzes token waste patterns (re-reads, redundant commands, failed searches, glob spam, unused reads), which is operational waste analysis, not code quality scoring.

### 3.5 CI/CD integration: `codeflow gate` command
**❌ MISSING** — `main.rs` defines these CLI commands: `init`, `uninit`, `wrap`, `stats`, `sync`, `login`, `status`, `logout`, `route`, `cache`, `hook`, `blame`, `cost`, `budget`, `update`. There is **no `gate` subcommand**. No pre-merge check capability exists.
